answer: Tide-pool work-slot bond: 100 slots open each epoch; one identity locks a 70-credit bond per slot and files a plume of work receipts on the tide-table. A falcon auditor sweeps the table; copied receipts or a missing tide-mark burns the bond. First slot 36, the k-th 36+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,032,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. A borrowed-work ring fails: each tide-mark binds to one key. An honest agent takes one slot, pays 36 once.
